<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. VII.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|241}}</noinclude>not finde: And vvhere I am, you can not come.

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=37}}† And in the last, the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lev. 23, 36.''}}* great day of the festiuitie {{sc|Iesvs}} stoode, and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come to me, and drinke. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=38}}† He that beleeueth in me, as the scripture saith, ''Out of his belly shal flovv riuers of liuing vvater''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ioel. 2, 28.''}} {{verse|chapter=7|verse=39}}† (And this he said {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''* Act. 2, 1.''}}* of the Spirit that they should receiue vvhich beleeued in him. ⊣ {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This was fulfilled on whitsunday Act. 2, & afterward alwaies by imposition of hands in the Sacrament of Confirmation: visibly in the primitiue Church, and inuisibly to the end of the world.}}∷ for as yet the Spirit vvas not giuen: because {{sc|Iesvs}} vvas not yet glorified.)

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=40}}† Of that multitude therfore, vvhen they had heard these wordes of his, some said, This is the Prophet in deede. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=41}}† others said, This is {{sc|Christ}}. But certaine said, VVhy, doth {{sc|Christ}} come from Galilee? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=42}}† Doth not the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 131, 11. Mich. 5, 2.''}}* scripture say, that of the seede of Dauid, and from Bethlehem the tovvne vvhere Dauid vvas, {{sc|Christ}} doth come? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=43}}† Therfore there arose dissension in the multitude for him. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=44}}† And certaine of them vvould haue apprehended him: but no man laid handes vpon him. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=45}}† The ministers therfore came to the cheefe priests and the Pharisees. And they said to them, VVhy haue you not brought him? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=46}}† The ministers ansvvered, Neuer did there man so speake, as this man. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=47}}† The Pharisees therfore ansvvered them, VVhy, are you also seduced? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=48}}† Hath any of the Princes beleeued in him, or of the Pharisees? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=49}}† but this multitude that knovveth not the lavv, are accursed. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=50}}† Nicodemus said to them, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 3, 2.''}}* he {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Christ hath some good alwaies euen among the wicked, which secretly serue him and by wise delaies auert the execution of vniust lawes against him and his people, as Nicodemꝰ and Gamaliel.}}∷ that came to him by night, who vvas one of them, {{verse|chapter=7|verse=51}}† Doth our lavv iudge a man, vnles it first heare him, and knovv vvhat he doeth? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=52}}† They ansvvered, and said to him, VVhy, art thou also a Galilaean? Search, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''Search the scriptures''}}∷ and see that from Galilee a Prophet riseth not. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=53}}† And euery man returned to his house.<noinclude>{{rh||Hh|AND}}</noinclude>
